name: Pridinol
summary: Pridinol, sold under the brand name Myopridin, is a muscle relaxant, anticholinergic and antiparkinsonian drug. It has also been evaluated for the treatment of muscle related pain.

pharmacology.text: Pridinol, sold under the brand name Myopridin, is a muscle relaxant, anticholinergic and antiparkinsonian drug.

uses.text: Pridinol, sold under the brand name Myopridin, is a muscle relaxant, anticholinergic and antiparkinsonian drug. It has also been evaluated for the treatment of muscle related pain. It was approved for medical use in the UK in May 2020.

sideEffects.en: Common effects come from its anticholinergic action: dry mouth, blurred vision, dizziness, constipation and difficulty passing urine. Too much can cause confusion and a fast heartbeat.
sideEffects.zh: 常見副作用來自其抗膽鹼作用：口乾、視力模糊、頭暈、便秘和排尿困難。過量可能引起意識混亂和心跳加快。
sideEffects.zhHans: 常见副作用来自其抗胆碱作用：口干、视力模糊、头晕、便秘和排尿困难。过量可能引起意识混乱和心跳加快。

fact.en: Pridinol is a close relative of trihexyphenidyl, a Parkinson's drug. Both carry a piperidine ring and a propanol chain, but pridinol has two benzene rings where trihexyphenidyl has one benzene ring and one cyclohexane ring.
fact.zh: Pridinol 和帕金森氏症藥物三己芬迪是近親。兩者都有哌啶環和丙醇鏈，但三己芬迪在該處是一個苯環和一個環己烷環，pridinol 則是兩個苯環。
fact.zhHans: Pridinol 和帕金森氏症药物三己芬迪是近亲。两者都有哌啶环和丙醇链，但三己芬迪在该处是一个苯环和一个环己烷环，pridinol 则是两个苯环。
